fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2025-08-10 states that a bicycle and some tools valued at around Rs. 85,000 was found missing from a premises near Sevvanthi Puram Industrial Area in Chittoor, on 2025-08-10 around 23:50 hrs. The complainant, Siva Velan, provided the contact number 9000000435. The complainant could not identify the person involved. A witness, Yuvaraj Selvam, reachable on 9000000434, was mentioned in the complaint. Hariharan Subramani (9000000044), described as a business acquaintance, was also mentioned in the complaint. Items referenced in the complaint: physical documents and photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Items reportedly taken while the premises were unattended.
fields.Keywords: property theft, valuables, associate, photograph, night, witness, documents, industrial area
